policy: No production dependency is promoted without sandbox benchmark, license review, causal-data review, and before/after evidence.

candidates.purpose: compact research backtesting and trade-result benchmarking
candidates.maintenance: active; pushed 2026-08-05; recent bug-fix and release activity
candidates.testsDocs: strong README, CI/coverage badges, substantial test suite
candidates.securityNotes: do not vendor or link into production without AGPL review; no market-data entitlement solved by this library
candidates.lookAheadRisk: medium if fed precomputed/final bars; must enforce point-in-time event boundaries externally
candidates.pattern: expectancy/profit-factor/drawdown outputs and deterministic scenario tests

candidates.purpose: SEC/EDGAR filing timing, 8-K/Form 4/13F/XBRL parsing and dilution/catalyst context
candidates.maintenance: active; pushed 2026-08-26; detailed recent fixes with regression tests
candidates.testsDocs: strong typed API, docs, thousands of tests referenced in recent commits
candidates.securityNotes: server-side only; respect SEC fair-access identity/rate limits; never expose private credentials in Pages
candidates.lookAheadRisk: low if SEC acceptance timestamp is preserved; high if amended/finalized fields are backfilled into earlier snapshots
candidates.pattern: immutable filing acceptedAt timestamps + amendment lineage + dilution/financing critic

candidates.purpose: deterministic event-time replay and research/live semantic parity
candidates.securityNotes: Rust/Python complexity and copyleft boundary require architecture review
candidates.lookAheadRisk: good primitives for event-time ordering, but caller must preserve causal timestamps

candidates.purpose: official REST/WebSocket/SSE SDK for live equity market data, news streams, paper trading and broker adapters
candidates.testsDocs: official SDK with documented StockDataStream/NewsDataStream, runtime validation and sandbox/paper environment
candidates.securityNotes: requires Alpaca account/API keys; never expose keys in GitHub Pages; websocket ingestion must run server-side; feed entitlement and exchange coverage must be benchmarked
candidates.lookAheadRisk: low for timestamped live streams if event time is persisted; historical API queries can introduce look-ahead if replay boundaries are not enforced
candidates.pattern: server-side websocket challenger against current 5-minute polling for detection latency and drop-rate measurement

candidates.purpose: large-scale parameter/replay experiments and walk-forward robustness checks for champion/challenger scoring
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 with Commons Clause / Fair Code
candidates.testsDocs: mature docs and CI; vectorized/Numba/Rust backtests, walk-forward optimization, signal ranking and performance analytics
candidates.securityNotes: not a production market-data solution; optional dependencies may carry different licenses; Commons Clause means no direct product embedding without legal review
candidates.lookAheadRisk: high if vectorized features are computed on final-session arrays without causal masking; acceptable only in sandbox with timestamp-bounded feature construction
candidates.pattern: fast challenger sweeps and walk-forward robustness tests, while keeping causal event replay outside vectorized final-bar shortcuts

candidates.purpose: normalized live/historical market-data ingestion with point-in-time definitions and event-driven market replay
candidates.maintenance: very active; official client pushed 2026-08-27 and repository updated 2026-08-28
candidates.testsDocs: official client with CI, documented live/historical APIs, MBO/MBP/top-of-book/last-sale/OHLCV schemas and event-driven replay
candidates.securityNotes: requires Databento API key and paid/entitled datasets for production-grade U.S. equity coverage; server-side only; credentials must never be exposed in GitHub Pages
candidates.lookAheadRisk: low if point-in-time definitions and event timestamps are preserved; historical range pulls must be bounded to replay clock and never enrich earlier events with later instrument state
candidates.pattern: benchmark timestamped live stream plus normalized historical replay against Yahoo polling for detection latency, event loss, trades-per-minute and order-flow feature availability
